+"""Scope counts for a fixture usage report."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import Counter
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from _pytest.fixtures import FixtureDef
+
+
+def fixture_scope_counts(
+    argnames: Sequence[str],
+    arg2fixturedefs: Mapping[str, Sequence[FixtureDef[object]]],
+    indirect: bool | Sequence[str],
+) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Count declared scopes of indirectly parametrized fixtures.
+
+    Use only the last definition for each requested fixture, and skip names
+    without a definition.
+    """
+    if not indirect:
+        return {}
+
+    indirect_names = set(argnames)
+    if isinstance(indirect, Sequence):
+        indirect_names.intersection_update(indirect)
+
+    return dict(
+        Counter(
+            fixturedefs[-1]._scope.value
+            for name, fixturedefs in arg2fixturedefs.items()
+            if name in indirect_names and fixturedefs
+        )
+    )
diff --git a/testing/test_fixture_scope_counts.py b/testing/test_fixture_scope_counts.py

--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_fixture_scope_counts.py
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+from _pytest.fixture_scope_counts import fixture_scope_counts
+from _pytest.fixtures import FixtureDef
+from _pytest.scope import Scope
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("argnames", "indirect", "expected"),
+    [
+        (
+            ["overridden", "other", "local", "missing", "empty"],
+            True,
+            {"module": 2, "function": 1},
+        ),
+        (
+            ["overridden", "other", "local"],
+            ("overridden", "unrequested"),
+            {"module": 1},
+        ),
+        (["overridden"], False, {}),
+        (["overridden"], [], {}),
+        ([], True, {}),
+        (["missing", "empty"], True, {}),
+    ],
+)
+def test_fixture_scope_counts(
+    pytestconfig: pytest.Config,
+    argnames: Sequence[str],
+    indirect: bool | Sequence[str],
+    expected: dict[str, int],
+) -> None:
+    def fixturedef(name: str, scope: Scope) -> FixtureDef[object]:
+        return FixtureDef(
+            pytestconfig, None, name, lambda: None, scope, None, _ispytest=True
+        )
+
+    arg2fixturedefs = {
+        "overridden": [
+            fixturedef("overridden", Scope.Session),
+            fixturedef("overridden", Scope.Module),
+        ],
+        "other": [fixturedef("other", Scope.Module)],
+        "local": [fixturedef("local", Scope.Function)],
+        "unrequested": [fixturedef("unrequested", Scope.Package)],
+        "empty": [],
+    }
+    assert fixture_scope_counts(argnames, arg2fixturedefs, indirect) == expected
notes:
The helper counts the last fixture definition for each indirectly parametrized name and skips missing and empty definitions. It returns scope-name counts without selecting an execution scope.
